name: Airtable MCP
tagline: Read, write, and automate Airtable bases from chat.
shortDescription: The Airtable MCP server. List bases and tables, query records, create and update rows, manage views, and run automations. Spreadsheets that an agent can actually touch.
longDescription:
## What it is

A community-built MCP server for Airtable. Exposes the Airtable API as MCP tools: list bases/tables, query records, create/update/delete rows, manage views, and trigger automations.

## Why we recommend it

If your team uses Airtable as a CRM, content calendar, or tracker, this is the cleanest way to let an agent help. The agent can query a table, update records, and even create new linked records.

## When to use it

- CRM: agent finds contacts, updates their stage, logs activities
- Content calendar: agent drafts social posts and schedules them
- Bulk operations: agent finds records matching a filter and updates them all
- Reporting: agent pulls aggregate stats and reports back
installInstructions:
1. Create a personal access token at https://airtable.com/create/tokens
2. Grant it `data.records:read`, `data.records:write`, and access to the bases you need
3. Set `AIRTABLE_TOKEN=...`
4. `npx -y @airtable/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Airtable free tier: 1,200 records per base. Team: $20/seat/month.
